SELECT so.bill_date AS date, SUM(sod.actual_qty) AS originalSalesQty, sb.shop_id AS shopId, sod.sku_id AS skuId FROM ${tableName} AS so INNER JOIN ${tableDetailName} AS sod ON so.id = sod.main_id AND sod.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN ${soB2cName} AS sb ON sb.is_deleted = FALSE AND sb.id = so.so_id WHERE so.is_deleted = FALSE AND sb.dict_platform = 'Amazon' AND sb.bill_date > #{localDate}
AND sb.label_json LIKE '%AFN%'
AND sb.label_json NOT LIKE '%AFN%'
GROUP BY so.bill_date, sod.sku_id, sb.shop_id

SELECT sb.platform_order_create_time::DATE AS date, SUM(sbd.qty) AS originalSalesQty, sb.shop_id AS shopId, sbd.sku_id AS skuId FROM ${tableName} AS sb INNER JOIN ${tableDetailName} sbd ON sbd.is_deleted = FALSE AND sb.id = sbd.main_id WHERE sb.is_deleted = FALSE AND sb.dict_platform = 'Amazon' AND sb.platform_order_create_time > #{localDate}
AND sb.label_json LIKE '%AFN%'
AND sb.label_json NOT LIKE '%AFN%'
GROUP BY sb.platform_order_create_time::DATE, sb.shop_id, sbd.sku_id
